title: Limit directory listing depth
summary: Use `du` to see disk usage for a directory and its subdirectories, but only up to a specific number of levels deep. This helps avoid overwhelming output from deeply nested folders.

steps.explain: Use `du -h -d` followed by the number of levels and the directory path to show sizes only for that many levels deep.

placeholders.name: LEVELS
placeholders.description: The maximum depth of subdirectories to list.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: The path to the folder you want to measure.
